topics: Exercises on lathe: - Plain and step turning.

Exercises on shaping machine: - Grooves and key ways.

Exercises on milling machine: - Spur gear  cutting operation.

Exercises on gas welding: - butt welding and lap welding of M.S. sheets.

Metallurgy: - Specimen preparation, etching & microscopic study of Steel, Cast iron and

Exercises on part quality inspection using machine vision systems.

courseOutcomes.description:
The students can operate different machine tools with understanding of work
holders and operating principles to produce different part features to the
desired quality.

Apply cutting mechanics to metal machining based on cutting force and
power consumption.

Programming and manufacturing of complex profiles in CNC machines with
high precision.

Fabricate and assemble various metal components by welding and students
will be able to visually examine their work and that of others for
discontinuities and defects.

Gain knowledge on the structure, properties, testing and applications of
ferrous and non ferrous metals.
